title: The Most Refreshing Drink
subgenre: Industrial ASMR lounge / fake sponsor bed
description: EyeWash sponsor for an over-engineered glass of ice water. Apparatus clicks in the dark lab; the gulp lands a beat before the ice. No sung lead.
stylePrompt: Industrial ASMR lounge / fake EyeWash sponsor bed at 76 BPM. Dark lab interior: pneumatic clicks, analog dial ticks, glycol-pump pulse, faint Tesla-coil fizz kept musical and quiet — not a sci-fi trailer. Soft Rhodes or wet electric piano, almost inaudible four-on-the-floor felt in the floor, no hats. When the camera is on the sunlit exterior desk, the top end may go clinical-bright (ice, glass, noon) — that contrast is the point; the lab side stays dark and worn. No sung vocal. Optional Continuity Voice, narrow bandwidth, small-print cadence only, never a jingle singer. **Structural flaw:** the gulp (a close, dry swallow sample) always happens one beat before the ice cube hits the glass. Every time. Do not reverse it. Do not “sync to picture” by moving the gulp onto the ice. Mood: the most refreshing drink in human history, played completely straight. Runtime ~1:20–1:40 (loopable 15–25s core for the lab cutaway). Instrumental only aside from one gulp and optional small print.
lyrics:
[Instrumental — no sung vocal]

[0:00–0:12 Lab clicks]
Dark magenta and blue LEDs. Pneumatic chambers bubble. Dials spin. Pump pulse locks to 76.

[0:12–0:28 Window apparatus]
Cryogenic vortex cannons. Frost on brass Joule-Thomson valves. Dry-ice fog over the sill. Still no gulp.

[0:28–0:44 Laminar droplets]
Laser-guided injector. Droplets that do not splash. Acoustic-levitation ice hovering a millimeter.

[0:44–0:52 The drink]
Gulp — dry, close, one beat early.
Ice hits the glass late.
Nobody comments.

[0:52–1:08 Repeat the pour]
Same apparatus. Same early gulp. Same late ice. Do not correct it.

[1:08–1:20 Small print (optional, spoken, not sung)]
Continuity Voice, unread speed:
Not a medical device. Do not rinse the eye with the product. Use the station.
Ultra-Refreshed. Because you're going to keep looking.

[1:20–1:35 Decay]
Pump winds down. One cube still hovering. Last gulp, still early. Ice, still late.

Visual bible: `ideas/ultra-refreshed-water-lab.md`. Prompts already exist: `prompts/ultra-refreshed-water-lab-segments.md`.
